papers.title: Accurate, Interdisciplinary and Transparent Structure-property Understanding with Deep Native Structural Reasoning
papers.abstract: Multimodal scientific foundation model for native structural reasoning across proteins, molecules and crystals. Discretizes structural elements into unified vocabulary, achieving state-of-the-art on 67 of 86 benchmarks.

papers.title: Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Latent-memory-native framework for VLA models that reconstructs historical experience into memory tokens. Enables temporal reasoning for long-horizon robotic tasks through coordinated memory components.

papers.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: DiT-based video pretraining with Mixture-of-Experts architecture for embodied AI. Integrates robot-oriented footage and multi-dimensional reward system to bridge digital creativity with physical actuation.

papers.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
papers.abstract: Advanced world modeling system achieving unbounded interaction horizons with real-time 60fps performance. Integrates pilot and director agents for multi-player collaborative virtual environments.

papers.title: RoboDojo: A Unified Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Comprehensive Evaluation of Generalist Robot Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Unified sim-and-real benchmark with 42 simulation and 18 real-world tasks evaluating generalist robot manipulation across five dimensions including generalization and long-horizon execution.

papers.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Asynchronous RL method replacing group-wise sampling with single-rollout sampling. Trains stably for 1000+ steps, outperforming GRPO on coding and reasoning benchmarks like SWE-Bench.

papers.title: Sparse Delta Memory: Scaling the State of Linear RNNs through Sparsity
papers.abstract: Architecture extending gated linear RNNs with sparse addressing to dramatically increase hidden state capacity. Improves long-context learning while maintaining computational efficiency under isoFLOP constraints.

papers.title: Automating the Design of Embodied Agent Architectures
papers.abstract: Agent Architecture Search system for embodied agents. Introduces AgentCanvas runtime and KDLoop search procedure, demonstrating deployable gains on vision-language navigation and manipulation tasks.

papers.title: OmniTacTune: Policy-Agnostic Real-World RL for Tactile Residual Adaptation of Visual Policies
papers.abstract: Two-stage RL pipeline adapting tactile feedback to visual robot policies. Improves success rates from 5-40% to 85-100% in contact-rich tasks within 40-80 minutes of interaction.

papers.title: AgentLens: Production-Assessed Trajectory Reviews for Coding Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract: Production-assessed benchmark for interactive code agents evaluating entire trajectories. Combines formal verification with LLM-written reviews for readable explanations of agent performance.

cc_updates.body: Added an auto mode rule that blocks tampering with session transcript files. Fixed --json-schema silently producing unstructured output when the schema was invalid, and schemas using the format keyword being rejected. Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being silently lost when the turn ended at the --max-turns limit. Fixed Windows worktree removal deleting files outside the worktree when an NTFS junction or directory symlink existed inside it. Fixed background agents staying shown as failed or completed in the agent list after being resumed with SendMessage. Fixed background jobs flipping from needs input back to working in the agent list when the agent turn contained no readable text. Fixed claude attach erroring when a background agent was mid-upgrade restart instead of waiting for it to come back.
Fixed hook events not streaming during SessionStart hooks in headless sessions, which could cause remote workers to be idle-reaped mid-hook.

Added a warning when your login is about to expire, so you can re-authenticate before background sessions are interrupted. Added a grey pause badge to the footer when in manual permission mode, making the active mode always visible. Added the session additional working directories to MCP roots/list. Fixed opening or switching background agent sessions on macOS stalling for 15-20 seconds due to a false low-memory detection. Fixed background sessions becoming permanently unresponsive to attach, replies, and stop when the daemon session token went stale. Fixed returning to claude agents silently stopping running subagents and re-running the prompt from scratch.
